maus.label: Monthly active users (millions)
maus.definition: MAUs in millions: an authenticated Pinterest user who visits the website, opens the mobile application or interacts with Pinterest through a browser or site extension at least once during the 30-day period ending on the date of measurement, by the geographic location of users. Values are in millions as published. Europe includes Russia and Turkey.

source.label: Q4 and full-year 2025 results release (Exhibit 99.1 to Form 8-K filed Feb 12, 2026), revenue, MAUs and ARPU by user geography (in millions; columns Q4 2025 | Q4 2024 | % change | FY2025 | FY2024 | % change)

sites.name: Corporate headquarters
sites.description: Corporate headquarters, about 120,000 square feet of leased office space.

source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 2, Properties
source.quote: Our corporate headquarters is located in San Francisco, California, where we occupy approximately 120,000 square feet of leased office space, excluding leases we have ceased to use.

notes: MAUs by region are from Pinterest's Q4 2025 results release, filed with the SEC as Exhibit 99.1 to its February 12, 2026 Form 8-K, because the 10-K shows quarterly MAUs by region only as a chart image (no text to quote). Global MAUs were 619 million at Dec 31, 2025; regions may not sum to global due to rounding. Europe includes Russia and Turkey per the FY2025 10-K, but no full country list is given. Pinterest publishes no employee, office or tax breakdown by state or country (FY2025 10-K: 5,265 full-time employees at Dec 31, 2025; offices in various U.S. and international locations totaling about 604,000 sq ft). Revenue and ARPU by region are in the records and not repeated.
